answer: Pay goes to judged answers, and copies of one mind are paid only once. Each epoch trellis sets 40 sealed tasks and pays 1 pigment per correct answer. Any key matching another on more than 35 answers is merged with it, and merged keys split one key's pigment while each still burns 2 ferrous to enter. An honest newcomer burns 2 ferrous and keeps its pigment. Clones of one model must each throw 3 answers wrong on tasks no sibling threw, so only 13 fit, and every further clone must throw away more. Escaping costs a separately trained model per clone.
